title: Thinker-WM: A Unified World Model with Shared Multimodal Representations for Embodied Intelligence
abstract: arXiv:2610.18447v2 Announce Type: new  Abstract: World models have emerged as a promising paradigm for embodied AI, yet existing systems often remain fragmented in the modalities they model and the functions they support. In particular, visual dynamics, geometric structure, and executable action are commonly coupled through separate interfaces or downstream modules rather than being jointly represented and evolved within a shared dynamics model. In this work, we present Thinker-WM, a unified multimodal world model that jointly models and generates RGB, metric depth, and robot action through a shared intermediate Unified Dynamics Transformer with modality-specific encoders and decoders. The model performs multimodal unification at the representation level: appearance, geometry, and action are transformed into a common dynamic representation and jointly evolved by shared parameters, while their distinct output structures are preserved. translated_title: Thinker-WM：面向具身智能的共享多模态表征统一世界模型
translated_abstract: 世界模型已成为具身智能领域一种有前景的范式，然而现有系统在所建模的模态和所支持的功能方面往往较为割裂。特别是，视觉动态、几何结构与可执行动作通常通过独立的接口或下游模块进行耦合，而非在共享的动力学模型中被联合表征和共同演化。在本工作中，我们提出了Thinker-WM，这是一个统一的多模态世界模型，它通过一个共享的中间统一动力学Transformer（配合模态特定的编码器和解码器），联合建模并生成RGB图像、度量深度和机器人动作。该模型在表征层面实现多模态统一：外观、几何和动作被转换为共同的动态表征，并由共享参数联合演化，同时保留了它们各自独特的输出结构。相同的参数化可支持多种功能……
tldr: 提出Thinker-WM，一个通过共享统一动力学Transformer在表征层面联合建模与生成RGB、度量深度和机器人动作的统一多模态世界模型，实现了外观、几何与动作的联合演化。
en_tdlr: Thinker-WM is a unified multimodal world model that jointly models and generates RGB, metric depth, and robot actions through a shared Unified Dynamics Transformer, achieving representation-level unification of appearance, geometry, and action.
